fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestWebToken shows pages without action controls and POST refused when no token is set, a POST refused with a wrong or missing token, the cookie set after a ?token= visit, and a bearer header accepted.
fields.statement: A web token (rhiza.web.token) turns on the web UI's actions: a browser presents it once with ?token= and keeps it in an HttpOnly cookie, a script sends it as a bearer header; without a token set, pages show no action controls and every POST is refused, and pages stay readable as today.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestWebAnswer|TestWebApprove' answers a question and approves a sign-off through POST with the token and the CSRF field, shows the confirmation, and refuses a POST missing the CSRF field.
fields.statement: From the web UI the owner answers an open question (question.answer) and approves a sign-off (inbox.approve or run.approve), with a CSRF check, and the page then says what happened ('Answered. The run continues.').

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestWebPause|TestWebActionsOnly' pauses and resumes the daemon and a project, and gets 404 or 405 for a POST to any other path, retry, abandon and merge included.
fields.statement: From the web UI the owner pauses or resumes the daemon or one project (rhiza.daemon.paused, rhiza.project.paused), and no other action exists: every other POST path is refused.
